baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel phrases بنعمة ربك and بمجنون place the Lord's favor beside the negated state of majnun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed good is carried through a relation of lordly repair and nurture, while madness is imaged as a veil over reason. The verse therefore grounds cognitive integrity in ongoing care rather than offering an unsupported self-defense.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the positive condition in the first bi-phrase and makes the denial rest on received good rather than self-certification.
Repair, nurture, and completion make 'your Lord' an active formative relation through which the favor sustains the addressee.
Madness as a veil over reason supplies the exact cognitive covering denied by the second bi-phrase.

changed_reading.before: A bare reassurance that the addressee is not insane.
changed_reading.after: The negation is relationally grounded: the Lord's favoring, completing care is incompatible with the veiling of reason named by majnun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person negation is interrupted by the possessive authority marker ربك and by نعمة before the charge مجنون is named.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage a conflict of classifications. A branch of نعم activates praise, lordship supplies authority, and the covering field of جنن makes the accusation something laid over a person; the verse removes that imposed classification while preserving the literal denial of madness.

activation_trace.role: Praise as excellent activates an evaluative edge within the favor word and functions as the positive appraisal opposed to the accusation.
Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the standing from which the counter-verdict is issued.
Covering and concealment give the public label material force as something that can obscure the person it purports to describe.
The mind-veiling branch keeps the counter-classification anchored in the ordinary charge of madness rather than dissolving it into a generic social theme.

changed_reading.before: Madness is denied as though it were a private clinical description.
changed_reading.after: The verse is also an authorized removal of a covering public verdict: the addressee stands under his Lord's favor and appraisal, not under the accusers' imposed class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pen and ordered writing externalize durable speech; the great inward disposition supplies continuity of character; mutual seeing, the question of al-maftun, and divine knowing turn the rival classifications into an assay whose result unfolds. The focus denial thus opens an evidentiary process rather than ending discussion by assertion.

activation_trace.role: The veil-over-reason image states the cognition charge that the following evidence will test.
The pared writing reed supplies inscription and functions as an external record against which coherence can be examined.
The aligned written row supplies ordered text and makes the utterance visibly structured rather than mentally scattered.
Inward disposition supplies a stable character witness and joins textual order to durable agency.
Physical seeing supplies the promised reciprocal observation and makes the rival claims answerable to what becomes manifest.
The assay of metal or person turns al-maftun into a test that separates soundness from defect.
Loss of reason or property keeps the competing mental-disorder sense live inside that assay instead of sanitizing the accusation.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies the final epistemic horizon in which the tested difference is uncovered.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:1 and 68:4-7 move from inscription to disposition to future mutual sight, then explicitly ask which party is al-maftun.
The focus negation precedes rather than replaces this staged disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, inward disposition, sight, assay, a mind-loss branch, and repeated knowing; I supply the arrow that durable output and conduct function as public evidence against the label. A live alternative is that these are parallel assurances without a single evidentiary chain.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks the hearer simply to accept a denial of madness.
changed_reading.after: The denial announces a testable claim: ordered revelation, sustained character, and coming perception will disclose which side actually bears disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context profiles falsification, reciprocal smoothing, fault-finding, tale-bearing, and fabricated attribution before threatening a mark on the snout. Within that speech ecology, majnun becomes a stigma deployed to cover a person and move listeners, not a neutral report of observed illness; the sequence reverses the mark onto the marker.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the material analogy for a stigma that obscures its target.
Mind-veiling supplies the literal content weaponized by the social label.
Attributing falsehood to a thing or its bearer supplies the practice of discrediting a speaker by classification.
Soft accommodation and dissimulation supply the desired reciprocal coating of differences and show speech being managed strategically.
Faulting and attacking people supplies the hostile evaluative act into which the madness charge fits.
Speech carried out as malicious report supplies the transmission mechanism by which a stigma circulates.
Saying what was not or attributing it supplies an explicit branch for manufactured verbal classification.
The nose or snout supplies the bodily site of the returned public mark and completes the reversal from stigmatizing to being stigmatized.

structural_cues: The branchless root و س م at 68:16 is used only as the structural cue of marking; no branch identity is assigned to it.
The catalogue of speech practices in 68:8-15 culminates immediately in the bodily marking scene of 68:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, dissimulation, faulting, tale-bearing, manufactured saying, and the uncited structural act of marking; I infer that majnun operates within this system as stigma. A live alternative is that the catalogue condemns the opponents generally without specifying the production of this particular label.

changed_reading.before: The verse corrects a sincere but mistaken diagnosis.
changed_reading.after: The verse unmasks a deliberate social technology of covering and discrediting; the accusers' label is itself evidence about their speech practice, and the marking is reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden narrative restages all three focus roots: a jannah is a tree-covered enclosure, its cultivated yield is treated as privately controllable, its owners become lost and deprived, and only then acknowledge their Lord; the arc ends with gardens of ease. This makes the focus a compact relation among gift, lordship, and covering: enclosure remains blessing when held under lordship, but possessive closure can itself veil judgment.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the gift whose right relation is later dramatized materially.
Lordship and ownership supply the governing relation that prevents a received good from being treated as autonomous possession.
The veil-over-reason branch supplies the cognitive enclosure whose denial is being re-explained.
The tree-covered garden materializes covering as a productive enclosure and lets the focus root move from diagnosis into economy and ecology.
Sowing and cultivation supply the labor-and-yield mechanism through which the enclosed gift becomes something the owners claim to control.
Straying from guidance or intended direction supplies the owners' first cognitive reading of the ruined garden and echoes the disputed soundness of judgment.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired yield expose the gift as non-autonomous and break the owners' closed claim.
Acknowledged lordship re-enters after loss and functions as the repaired ownership relation.
Easeful living supplies the arc's restored garden-state and distinguishes received delight from possessive closure.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:17-34 form a sequence of enclosed garden, secret exclusion, failed recognition, deprivation, mutual blame, repentance, and promised gardens of ease.
The sequence repeats the focus roots ج ن ن, ر ب ب, and ن ع م in a material narrative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three-root recurrence and the ordered garden failure; I supply the arrow that refusal to hold bounty under lordship turns physical enclosure into a model of covered judgment. A live alternative is that the root recurrence links scenes poetically without making possession a cause of cognitive covering.

changed_reading.before: Favor merely serves as proof that madness is absent.
changed_reading.after: The verse names a right relation among gift, Lord, and cover: acknowledged lordly bounty keeps the recipient from the enclosed judgment later dramatized by the garden owners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interrogative sequence asks what authorizes judgment: a studied writing, binding oaths, a guarantor, partners, truth, or access to the hidden. Applied back to majnun, the accusation is an adverse ruling about an inward state whose speakers cannot produce record, warrant, or access; the focus counter-verdict therefore wins not only by authority but by exposing the rival verdict's missing basis.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority supply the focus verse's positive jurisdiction.
Veiling of reason supplies the inward condition over which the opponents presume to rule.
Judgment between people supplies the forensic frame and turns the charge into a verdict requiring grounds.
Written establishment that imposes judgment supplies the kind of binding record the accusers do not possess.
Following a book through reading and retention supplies the examination needed to claim textual warrant.
The oath supplies a binding guarantee and sharpens the question of whether any enduring authorization exists.
Speech without certainty supplies the precise epistemic weakness of an unsupported madness claim.
Truthful speech supplies the explicit verification condition against which the claimants are challenged.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain the accusers implicitly claim to know.
Joining letters into writing supplies the imagined record of hidden knowledge and exposes its absence.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:35-41 repeatedly interrogate comparison, judgment, book, study, oath, guarantor, partners, and truth.
Ayah 68:47 closes the warrant problem by pairing possession of the hidden with writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained audit of verdicts and their warrants; I apply that audit backward to the inward-state allegation in 68:2 and infer that it lacks jurisdiction and evidence. A live alternative is that the questions concern eschatological entitlement only, with no backward legal force on the madness charge.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's word simply outranks the opponents' word.
changed_reading.after: The opponents' diagnosis collapses under the surah's own evidentiary questions: they have neither record, guarantee, truthful proof, nor access to the hidden mind they classify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fish-companion sequence gives نعمة من ربه a counterfactual mechanics: favor catches a constricted caller before he is cast into exposed space while blameworthy, after which his Lord selects him and makes him sound. The near repetition of the focus phrase concretizes favor as timely interception, protection from stigmatized exposure, and formative restoration.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the focus condition whose operation the later counterfactual makes visible.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative agency latent in the focus possessive phrase.
Mind-veiling supplies the stigmatized condition from which the focus addressee is distinguished.
A blocked outlet after fullness supplies the constricted interior state from which the fish-companion calls.
Catching up and reaching supplies the temporal interception by which favor arrives before the threatened outcome.
The repeated bestowed-favor branch identifies the intercepting agent-condition with the focus noun.
The repeated nurturing Lord branch ties rescue to the same formative relation named in the focus.
Throwing and casting supply the averted expulsion and make favor an interruption of trajectory.
Open space without cover supplies the averted exposure and creates a sharp cover-versus-bare contrast with جنن.
Blame and fault supply the averted stigmatized status, linking rescue from exposure to rescue from adverse naming.
Selection and drawing near supply the positive reversal of being cast away.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the completed state produced after rescue.

structural_cues: Ayah 68:49 explicitly orders a counterfactual: without favor reaching him, casting into bare space while blamed would have followed.
Ayah 68:50 immediately reverses casting into selection and blame into made soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit counterfactual, the near-repeated نعمة/رب phrase, and the rescue-to-selection sequence; I infer that this later event specifies how lordly favor can underwrite the focus denial. A live alternative is that the fish-companion is only a warning contrast and does not explain the favor of 68:2.

changed_reading.before: Favor is an undefined honor attached to the denial of madness.
changed_reading.after: Favor has event-shape: it reaches before expulsion, blocks bare and blame-laden exposure, draws near, and completes soundness; the focus denial carries that rescuing and rehabilitating force.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, the opponents hear the reminder, nearly make the addressee slip from his station with their eyes, and then say the exact madness charge; the next ayah reclassifies the utterance as reminder. Hearing triggers hostile seeing and verbal naming, so majnun functions within an attempted displacement rather than as the result of neutral perception. The covering branches of both كفر and جنن also permit a projection reading: those covering truth place a mind-cover over the speaker.

activation_trace.role: The mind-veiling branch supplies the original charge that returns verbatim in the closing scene.
Covering the truth supplies the opponents' perceptual stance and enables the projection reversal without replacing the ordinary sense of disbelief.
Slipping something from its station on an unstable surface supplies the attempted physical and social displacement.
Eye-sight supplies the hostile instrument aimed at displacement, reversing sight from evidence into pressure.
Auditory perception supplies the triggering encounter with the reminder and precedes the hostile gaze and label.
That which makes one remember supplies the actual function of the heard utterance that provokes the attack.
Saying what was not or attributing it supplies the performative act by which the madness label is attached.
The repeated mind-veiling branch closes the ring and identifies the exact accusation as part of the displacement scene.
The repeated reminder branch supplies the immediate counter-classification of the allegedly mad utterance.

structural_cues: Ayah 68:51 orders hearing, hostile gaze, attempted slipping, and the spoken phrase إنه لمجنون in one scene.
The exact focus charge returns near the end and is answered immediately by وما هو إلا ذكر in 68:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered perception-displacement-label sequence and the reminder correction; I supply the causal arrow that the label participates in the attempt to unseat the addressee. A live alternative is that hostile gaze and verbal accusation are parallel reactions rather than one coordinated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Majnun describes what the opponents think they see in the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Majnun is a verbal projectile launched after hearing a disruptive reminder: it tries to move the speaker from his station, while the closing correction reveals the utterance as remembrance rather than mind-veiling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the shield and garden branches do not give the lexical sense of مجنون here. It remains anchored because the same focus root explicitly carries mind-veiling and protective-cover branches, while the context materializes garden-cover and repeats favor as rescue. Render it only as a root-image reversal: one cover is negated while another protects, never as a claim that majnun literally means shielded or gardened.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places favor directly against a passive-form word from a root whose inventory includes both harmful mind-covering and protective covering.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the positive medium in which protection can be imagined.
Madness veiling reason supplies the harmful cover explicitly negated.
The protective shield supplies the opposite-valence cover and enables the contained reversal.
The tree-covered garden gives the root a visibly life-bearing enclosure in the same surah.
Repeated favor as the condition averting exposed casting supplies the later protective action.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is simply not covered by madness.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained root imagery, harmful cognitive cover is negated while favor supplies a protective, life-bearing cover around the addressee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped ر ب و target under the focus root ر ب ب and pairs it with a branch-distant 'adding further' image from نعم. It remains packet-valid through the explicit split mapping and the later رب/selection/making-sound sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary developmental resonance, not replace the ordinary meaning of rabb or the direct denial of madness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The words نعمة ربك stand between the addressee and the negated mind-veiling, allowing the packet's increase and nurture branches to activate a trajectory rather than a static status.

activation_trace.role: Adding and carrying an act further supplies a developmental edge within the favor word.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nourishment and growing up supplies ongoing formation rather than static patronage.
Mind-veiling supplies the fixed adverse state that the developmental reading refuses to let define the addressee.
The repeated non-dominant nourishment branch carries the growth resonance into the later sequence of divine action.
Selection and drawing near supply a directed transition rather than a mere reversal of label.
Fitness or suitability supplies the attained condition toward which nurture and selection move.

changed_reading.before: The verse defends a fixed mental status at one moment.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary split-root resonance, the verse protects an ongoing trajectory of favoring growth: lordly nurture carries the addressee toward fitness, so a hostile label cannot freeze the process into mind-veiling.

strongest_changes: Inscription, character, sight, and assay turn the focus denial into an inspectable claim whose truth unfolds.
The speech catalogue and marking reversal make majnun a circulated stigma rather than a neutral diagnosis.
The garden arc reuses all three focus roots to model how gift, lordship, and covering can preserve or distort judgment.
The counterfactual نعمة من ربه scene gives favor concrete mechanics: reaching before casting, averting bare blame, selecting, and making sound.
The closing repetition makes the charge part of an attempted displacement provoked by hearing reminder, then immediately reclassifies the utterance as reminder.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact نعمة/رب/جنن relation is not merely echoed but repeatedly operationalized across textual evidence, social labeling, garden economy, forensic warrant, rescue, and the closing gaze-and-speech scene. These mechanisms support coexisting epistemic, social, material, legal, and protective readings without forcing one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal force assigned to the first bi-phrase is plausible but stronger than a purely circumstantial or emphatic reading.
The garden model depends on an inferred arrow from possessive exclusion to covered judgment; the packet guarantees recurrence and sequence, not that causality.
The protective-cover and split-root growth readings are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified secondary activations.
